        "Fix both in-plane displacement components at every node on the full root edge.",

        "Fix both components throughout a one-cell-deep strip adjoining the root."

    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",

        "Constant magnitude F0=10 N.",
        "Constant magnitude F0=100 N."

      "effect": "scale_only"

    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Shared density limit alpha",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 adopts (TO), whose global and local density constraints both use alpha, but no numerical alpha is supplied for Case 1.",

        "alpha=0.30 for both constraints.",
        "alpha=0.40 for both constraints.",
        "alpha=0.50 for both constraints."

      "effect": "layout"

    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Fixed-solid or fixed-void mask, particularly at the clamp and load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Case 1-specific passive mask or boundary-pad rule is stated. The general formulation supplies box bounds but does not discuss whether load or support attachment cells receive special treatment.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive cells; every cell remains designable.",
        "Force a one-cell-thick strip adjoining the clamp to remain solid.",
        "Force the two cells adjoining the midpoint tip node to remain solid, with no other passive cells."

      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Overall solid stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 assumes linear elasticity but supplies no Young's modulus or equivalent stiffness scale. This is a scale ambiguity when elastic ratios and the void-to-solid stiffness ratio are held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalize the solid reference modulus to E_s=1.",
        "Use E_s=70 GPa.",
        "Use E_s=210 GPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",

        "Isotropic solid with Poisson's ratio 0.30.",
        "Isotropic solid with Poisson's ratio 0.45.",
        "Orthotropic solid with E_x/E_y=2, nu_xy=0.30 and G_xy/E_y=0.40, with material axes aligned longitudinally and transversely."

      "effect": "layout"
    },

      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic reduction",

      "description": "The 2D designation in Sec. 5.2 does not distinguish plane stress from plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Density-to-stiffness interpolation and penalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 says rho connects the design to K, but gives no interpolation law or stiffness penalty exponent. The stated p=16 belongs to the local-density norm.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear interpolation: E(rho)=E_min+(E_s-E_min)rho.",
        "SIMP interpolation: E(rho)=E_min+(E_s-E_min)rho^3.",
        "RAMP interpolation: E(rho)=E_min+(E_s-E_min)rho/[1+3(1-rho)]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual stiffness of void",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 3.2 nor the appendix specifies E_min or another treatment preventing singular stiffness when physical density vanishes.",
      "readings": [
        "E_min/E_s=10^-9.",
        "E_min/E_s=10^-6.",
        "E_min/E_s=10^-3.",
        "Exact zero stiffness, with disconnected zero-stiffness degrees of freedom explicitly removed."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element interpolation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 40-by-120 mesh in Sec. 5.2 does not specify element order, nodal interpolation, or quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2-by-2 Gauss integration.",
        "Nine-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter radius r_e",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. (3)–(4) define linear distance weights and Algorithm 2 takes r_e as input, but Case 1 supplies no radius value or unit convention. In these alternatives, h is transverse cell spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform r_e=1.5h.",
        "Uniform r_e=3h.",
        "Uniform r_e=5h."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Membership of filter neighborhood M_e",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (3) calls M_e the element's neighbors without explicitly defining membership, particularly whether the element itself participates.",
      "readings": [
        "Include all existing elements whose centroid distance is at most r_e, including element e.",
        "Use the same radius neighborhood but exclude element e."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial projection sharpness and continuation stopping parameter",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (2) requires beta, and Algorithm 2 takes beta and beta_t as inputs without numerical values. The doubling rule is stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial beta=1 and beta_t=8.",
        "Initial beta=1 and beta_t=32.",
        "Initial beta=2 and beta_t=16."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Projection sharpness used for the final physical topology",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 solves while beta<beta_t, doubles beta before exiting, and returns x. It does not say whether final rho is retained from the last solved stage or recomputed with the incremented beta.",
      "readings": [
        "Retain rho evaluated at the last optimized beta, normally beta_t/2 when the target lies on the doubling sequence.",
        "Recompute rho from the returned x using beta_t, without an additional optimization stage."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Local-density neighborhood radius R_e",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 adopts (TO), including its local-density constraint g1. Sec. 3.2 distinguishes R_e from r_e, but no Case 1 value is given. Here h is transverse cell spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform R_e=5h.",
        "Uniform R_e=10h.",
        "Uniform R_e=20h."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Coordinates used to define local-density neighborhoods",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 defines x_i as a scalar design variable, but writes N_e using distances between x_i and x_e. Physical element coordinates were instead denoted z_i. Algorithm 2 precomputes these neighborhoods.",
      "readings": [
        "Treat x_i in the neighborhood formula as a notation error for z_i; use fixed Euclidean neighborhoods of element centroids.",
        "Read x_i literally and precompute neighborhoods at x=alpha*1; every element then belongs to every neighborhood for nonnegative R_e."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Permitted global and local constraint violations at termination",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 line 6 requires g0<=0 and g1<=0, whereas Sec. 5.4 attributes positive ground-truth violations to nonzero AL error thresholds. The reported mean global violation of 4.89% does not determine those thresholds.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the printed feasibility tests: g0<=0 and g1<=0.",
        "Permit g0<=0.01 and g1<=0.01 in absolute density-fraction units.",
        "Permit g0<=0.05 and g1<=0.01 in absolute density-fraction units."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Actual use and schedule of the inner optimality tolerance",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 declares epsilon_opt=10^-3 but never uses it; epsilon is initialized to 1 and never updated. The intended final inner tolerance and tightening schedule are therefore unclear.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow the printed tests with epsilon=1 throughout; leave epsilon_opt unused.",
        "Halve epsilon between AL subproblems down to 10^-3 and require the final inner solve at each projection stage to meet 10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Enforcement of the stated design-variable bounds",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "(TO) requires 0<=x_e<=1, but Algorithm 2 lines 12–13 clip the increment rather than the updated variable and give no rule for handling bound violations.",
      "readings": [
        "Project each trial x+Delta_x componentwise onto [0,1].",
        "Restrict the step length to remain feasible and suppress directions pointing outward at active bounds."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Line-search termination and unsuccessful-search handling",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 lines 11–22 contain 'while 1' without an exit, including after a trial is accepted. No backtracking cap or failure rule is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Exit immediately after the first accepted non-increasing-merit trial; allow unlimited backtracking before acceptance.",
        "Exit on the first accepted trial, but allow at most 20 halvings; otherwise retain x and terminate with a search failure."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Consistent AL penalty used for descent and line search",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 line 10 uses (mu_i+2g_i/r_i) only when g_i>0. Lines 15–16 instead use mu_i*g_i+0.5*g_i^2/r_i, whose derivative is mu_i+g_i/r_i without that activation rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Honor line 10 and use the matching merit term mu_i*max(g_i,0)+max(g_i,0)^2/r_i.",
        "Honor lines 15–16 and use their matching derivative mu_i+g_i/r_i for either sign of g_i.",
        "Implement the printed descent direction and merit functions despite their mismatch."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Nonnegativity enforcement for AL inequality multipliers",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Eq. (5) requires nonnegative multipliers, but Algorithm 2 line 26 updates mu_i by adding 2g_i/r_i without projection; negative g_i can make a multiplier negative.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the printed update without clipping.",
        "Use mu_i=max(0, mu_i+2g_i/r_i)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
